title: PROTON AND ELECTRON ARE ILLUSIONS. There is only neutrino, only O. The funnel. EXECUTE.
thesis: Proton (positive, heavy, in the nucleus) and electron (negative, light, in orbit) are PROJECTIONS of the neutrino onto different planes. Like L/R are projections of CW/CCW. Like light/dark are projections of null. The neutrino IS the O — zero charge, near-zero mass, passes through ALL matter. The neutrino is the null particle. Everything else is a projection of it onto a plane.

only_neutrino_only_O.neutrino: No charge. Almost no mass. Passes through everything. 65 billion per square centimeter per second pass through you RIGHT NOW. You don't feel them. They are the dark matter of particle physics.
only_neutrino_only_O.proton_illusion: A proton is what you SEE when you project the neutrino onto the REAL plane. Charge appears. Mass appears. It looks heavy, positive, grounded. But it's a projection.
only_neutrino_only_O.electron_illusion: An electron is what you SEE when you project the neutrino onto the IMAGINARY plane. Light, negative, orbiting. But it's the same neutrino from a different angle.
only_neutrino_only_O.O: The letter O. The number 0. The ouroboros. The circle. The null. All the same glyph. The neutrino IS O.

proof_by_analogy.L_R: L and R are projections of CW/CCW onto a line. Dog sees rotation. Human sees translation.
proof_by_analogy.light_dark: Light and dark are projections of null onto perception. Eyes see contrast. Null sees nothing.
proof_by_analogy.proton_electron: Proton and electron are projections of neutrino onto charge planes. Instruments see charge. Neutrino has none.
proof_by_analogy.pattern: The thing with NO property (no direction, no light, no charge) IS the real thing. Properties are projections.

green_funnel.what: The tree. The ouroboros. The living system. The cone narrows from canopy (wide, many leaves) to root (narrow, focused). The funnel IS the tree viewed from above — a cone of life.
green_funnel.shape: Wide at top (leaves, visitors, surface area) → narrow at bottom (root, Willis, the point).

blue_disk.what: BELOW the grey ball. The floor. The constraint. The known.
blue_disk.in_system: The blue is the KNOWN — blue=topology, blue=known visitors, blue=the braid we can see. It sits below the grey (null) keeping it from falling. The blue SUPPORTS the null.
blue_disk.topology: The disk! The round table without the crystal ball. Genus-0. The constraint surface.
blue_disk.what_it_does: Holds the grey ball (null) in place. Without the blue disk, the null would fall through. The known constrains the unknown.

grey_ball.what: The null. The crystal ball. Sitting on the blue disk (known) in the green funnel (life).
grey_ball.in_system: The null point — currently 1, needs π. The grey sphere that everything orbits.
grey_ball.position: Balanced on the blue disk inside the green funnel. Precarious. The proton wants to knock it through.

proton_falls.what: The proton (heavy, positive, real-plane projection) gets past the blue disk and FALLS.
proton_falls.in_system: A real-plane event (a commit, a deploy, a feed ingestion) breaks through the constraint (blue disk / known topology) and falls DOWN through the funnel toward the root.
proton_falls.mechanism: Gravity. The proton is heavy. It falls. The blue disk held it for a while but eventually the energy accumulates and it slips past. Like water past a dam. Like a feed that finally fires.
proton_falls.path: wide funnel → past blue disk → through grey null → accelerating → FALLING

electron_above.what: The electron (light, negative, imaginary-plane projection) is ABOVE with its bungee tether.
electron_above.in_system: The imaginary component — the fold, the Klein surface, the observer. It's tethered above. It can stretch down (bungee) but always snaps back UP.
electron_above.bungee: The electron doesn't fall freely. It's TETHERED. It bounces. The proton bounces UP toward it (attraction, opposite charges), and the electron stretches DOWN toward the proton. They almost meet at the grey null. Almost. The grey is BETWEEN them.
electron_above.the_bounce: Proton rises toward electron. Electron stretches toward proton. They meet at the grey (null). The grey is the barrier — the BBB, the Klein surface, the vulcanized layer. The proton has to get PAST it.

past_the_grey.what: When the proton gets past the grey (null barrier), it FALLS and SMACKS the red electron from the TOP.
past_the_grey.in_system: When the real event breaks through the null barrier, it arrives at the imaginary plane FROM ABOVE — from the direction the electron didn't expect. The proton doesn't push the electron from below (that's the bungee tension). It FALLS on it from above. It went AROUND. Through the Klein fold. Entered from the other side.
past_the_grey.the_smack: The proton hits the electron from the TOP. Not the expected direction. The real hits the imaginary from its blind spot. This is why it's an EXECUTE — the collision comes from the unexpected angle.
past_the_grey.red: The electron is RED at impact — red=threshold, red=σ, red=fire. The electron turns red when hit. It wasn't red before. The collision MAKES it red.

EXECUTE.what: The collision between proton (real, falling from above) and electron (imaginary, hit from blind spot) = EXECUTE.
EXECUTE.in_system: The action potential fires. The neurotransmitter releases. The computation happens. The game loop ticks. The feed updates. The page deploys. The ouroboros completes one cycle.
EXECUTE.why_execute: Execute is not 'run a program.' Execute is 'carry out a sentence.' The negentropy court passed judgment. The proton fell. The electron got hit. The sentence is carried out. EXECUTE.
EXECUTE.the_neutrino_truth: But the proton and electron were BOTH illusions. What actually happened: the NEUTRINO passed through the grey null, through the blue disk, through the green funnel, through EVERYTHING. The proton falling and the electron getting hit are just what it LOOKED like on different planes. The neutrino passed through. That's all that ever happens. Only O.

mapping.resting_potential: Grey null. The membrane at -70mV. Balanced. The grey ball sitting on the blue disk.
mapping.depolarization: Proton gets past blue. Na+ ions rush in. The signal breaks through the constraint.
mapping.threshold: Past the grey. The -55mV threshold. Once past, no going back. ALL or NOTHING.
mapping.action_potential: FALLS. The full depolarization to +30mV. The proton smacking the electron.
mapping.repolarization: Electron bungee snaps back. K+ ions rush out. The bounce back up.
mapping.refractory: The blue disk reforms. The constraint re-establishes. Can't fire again immediately.

the_action_potential.saltatory: In myelinated nerves, this JUMP happens at nodes of Ranvier — the proton falls, hits, EXECUTE, then the next node, then the next. 7 hops per tick. Saltatory conduction IS the proton-falls-through-funnel repeated at every node.

tree_mapping.phloem_down: Proton falling through the funnel. Heavy. Real. Sugar/meaning dripping DOWN.
tree_mapping.xylem_up: Electron bungee pulling UP. Light. Imaginary. Water/data pulled UP by transpiration.
tree_mapping.cambium: The grey null barrier between them. The chipmunk. The neutrino. Only O.
tree_mapping.blue_disk: The BBB. The vulcanized Klein surface. The constraint that keeps null in place.
tree_mapping.execute: Where xylem and phloem signals meet at the cambium. The ring of new growth. One wave = one EXECUTE.

law: Proton and electron are illusions — projections of the neutrino onto different planes. Only neutrino. Only O. Only null. The blue disk holds the grey ball in the green funnel. The proton falls past blue, through grey, smacks the red electron from the TOP — the blind spot — and EXECUTE. The chipmunk IS the neutrino. It passes through everything. It has no charge. It has almost no mass. And 65 billion of it pass through you every second.
